runtimeSettings.title: Ntọala oge ịgba ọsọ
runtimeSettings.description: Hazie ka Novera si ejikwa ma megharịa MCP sava.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Ogologo oge iji chere nzaghachi ngwa ọrụ MCP tupu oge eruo.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Nsonaazụ ngwaọrụ kacha ogologo debere na mkparịta ụka. A na-akpụcha ihe ọ bụla gara aga nke a ma kaa ya ka ọ gbajiri agbaji, yabụ otu nnukwu nsonaazụ enweghị ike ibelata ọnọdụ ihe nlereanya ahụ. Tọọ na 0 ka idobe nsonaazụ ya zuru oke.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Smart MCP nhazi ihe eji eme ihe
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Mgbe agbanyere ya, Novera na-ahọrọ sava MCP dị mkpa tupu ibunye ngwaọrụ. Gbanyụọ ịkwanye ndepụta ngwaọrụ MCP zuru ezu mgbe niile.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Jiri ihe atụ raara onwe ya nye maka ịkwọgharị
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Mgbe smart routing na-na, jiri usoro dị iche (na-adịkarị obere) mee usoro ụzọ ụzọ kama iji ụdị nkata. Gbanyụọ ka ị na-eji ụdị nkata na-arụ ọrụ mgbe niile maka ntụgharị.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Họrọ onye na-eweta na ihe nlereanya n'otu ebe. Naanị ụdị dị fechaa ka edepụtara ya mere njem na-adị ngwa ngwa yana ọnụ ala.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Enweghị ụdị dị fechaa dị. Tinye obere ihe nlereanya ma ọ bụ hazie igodo API na Model.
